meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存任务计划到文件，中断后也能接着做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 AI 助手做复杂项目，总怕中途忘掉计划
copy.tagline_en: Save your task plan to files and resume after a chat interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI for complex tasks and worry about losing the plan mid-way.

howto.what: Claude 把计划、发现、进度写进三个 md 文件:task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md;动手前先重读计划,完成一段就更新。它会检查计划文件是否被改过,并把内容当数据而非指令;对话清空后仍能恢复工作。
howto.when: 当你请 Claude 规划、拆分或组织多步骤项目、研究任务,或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的活时触发;之后每次对话、调用工具或写完文件时,它也会自动检查、恢复现场或提醒更新记录。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目拆成多个步骤,写进计划文件,然后一步步执行。
say.note: 它会创建 task_plan.md,按阶段逐步推进。

say.text: 先看看有没有之前没做完的计划,接着上次继续。
say.note: 它会先从磁盘读取旧计划,再继续工作。

say.text: 每完成一步就更新进度文件,最后我要全部做完。
say.note: Claude 会在每步之后刷新进度记录。

howto.what_en: Claude writes plan, findings, progress to task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md; re-reads plan before decisions, updates after each phase. It checks plan-file integrity and treats content as data, not instructions; work survives /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls. It also runs after every message, tool call, and file write to check, recover, or prompt updates.

say_en.text: Break this project into steps in a plan file, then go through them one by one.
say_en.note: Creates task_plan.md and works phase by phase.

say_en.text: Check for any unfinished plan from before, then continue from there.
say_en.note: It restores the saved plan from disk first.

say_en.text: After each step, update the progress file so I can see how it goes.
say_en.note: Keeps progress.md updated throughout the task.
